traits.name: Flyby
traits.text: The wasp doesn’t provoke an Opportunity At- tack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: The hippopotamus can hold its breath for 10 minutes.

actions.name: Ram
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Blud- geoning damage, or 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage if the goat moved 20+ feet straight toward the target immedi- ately before the hit. Hawk
